## Gorrlon (CR 11)

This creature is tall, lanky, hunched and boasts an oversized head. Its perceived danger grows when you notice cords of lean muscle moving under the bronze, reptilian skin. The creature hisses, baring its teeth and looks upon you with a predatory gaze.  


**XP** 12,800  
N Large monstrous humanoid  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft., scent; Perception +29  


**Defense**


**AC** 26, touch 14, flat-footed 21 (+1 dodge, +4 Dex, +12 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 208 (13d10+78)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +12, **Will** +13  
**Immune** poison; **SR** 22  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** mwk double glaive +22/+22/+17/+17/+12/+12 (2d6+8/19-20/x3 plus poison), bite +15 (1d8+4), 2 tail slaps +15 (1d8+4) Ranged javelin +16 (1d8+8) or net +16 ranged touch (entangle)  
**Special Attacks** studied target +3 (3rd, swift action)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 27, **Dex** 19, **Con** 22, **Int** 13, **Wis** 20, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +13; **CMB** +22; **CMD** 37  
**Feats** Double Slice, [Improved Two-Weapon Fighting](../../rules/feats/improved-two-weapon-fighting.md), Harvest Parts, Improved Critical (double glaive), Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Focus (double glaive), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md)  
*House rules: Greater Two-Weapon Fighting and Improved Two-Weapon Fighting are one feat, Improved Two-Weapon Fighting; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Craft (taxidermy) +17, Intimidate +15, Perception +29, Stealth +24, Survival +29; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Perception, +8 Stealth, +8 Survival  
**Languages** Common, Gorrlon  
**SQ** poison savant, hunter’s expertise  


**Special Abilities**


**Hunter’s Expertise (Ex)** A gorrlon can attempt knowledge checks to identify creatures, their abilities and weaknesses untrained, adding its Wisdom modifier in addition to its Intelligence modifier to the roll. A gorrlon gains the slayer’s studied target ability, counting its HD as the slayer level.  

**Poison Savant (Ex)** When a gorrlon applies poison to a weapon, the weapon remains poisoned for a number of hits equal to the gorrlon’s Wisdom modifier (minimum 1, 5 for most gorrlons). A gorrlon is treated as if it had the poison use class feature for the purpose of fulfilling prerequisites. When a gorrlon confirms a critical hit with a poisoned weapon, it increases the save DC of the poison by an amount equal to the weapon’s critical multiplier. A gorrlon often poisons its double glaive before going after dangerous prey. This particular gorrlon uses wyvern poison.
